source.citation: SPACE Kerala (Melwin Sunny and Shaiju T), Thooval Malayalam alphabet learning tool, formation arrows for ഗ in data/GA.png: green start, blue turn, red end (GPL-3.0, 2013)
source.variation: Thooval's GA.png starts at the top of the left bowl (green), curves counterclockwise down round it, climbs the middle stem and sweeps clockwise over the right arch to finish at its foot (red). Thooval is a GPL-3.0 teaching tool, so only these facts are cited; no image, path or template point is copied. It asks the learner to keep the pen down to the end of every letter, so its single run is checked against two recorded sources that could have shown a lift. Santhosh Thottingal's hand reference curves (gitlab.com/santhoshtr/hand, MIT, 2019), which keep several strokes where a glyph has them, record ഗ as one stroke from the upper left to the lower right. The grahyam online-handwriting samples (github.com/bluebottlewize/grahyam, no licence, cited as counts only) keep no pen-up marker, but none of the 107 unique samples jumps between consecutive points the way a lift would; they most often start at the upper left (86 of 107) and end at the lower right (85 of 107). The path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Malayalam outline rather than to Thooval's letterforms.

source.citation: SPACE Kerala (Melwin Sunny and Shaiju T), Thooval Malayalam alphabet learning tool, formation arrows for വ in data/VA.png: green start, blue turn, red end (GPL-3.0, 2013)
source.variation: Thooval's VA.png starts at the left foot (green), climbs clockwise over the tall arch, comes down to the line, runs right along the base and climbs the upright to finish at its top (red). Thooval is a GPL-3.0 teaching tool, so only these facts are cited; no image, path or template point is copied. It asks the learner to keep the pen down to the end of every letter, so its single run is checked against two recorded sources that could have shown a lift. Santhosh Thottingal's hand reference curves (gitlab.com/santhoshtr/hand, MIT, 2019), which keep several strokes where a glyph has them, record വ as one stroke from the lower left to the upper right. The grahyam online-handwriting samples (github.com/bluebottlewize/grahyam, no licence, cited as counts only) keep no pen-up marker, but none of the 31 unique samples jumps between consecutive points the way a lift would; they most often start at the lower left (28 of 31) and end at the upper right (31 of 31). The path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Malayalam outline rather than to Thooval's letterforms.

source.variation: The 97-frame Gayathri-font animation draws ൺ in one uninterrupted run: compact inner loop, broad outer-left bowl, first central stem, middle arch and second stem, right loop, then the finishing hook above the line.
